roadTrip.title: Great Ocean Road Loop

officialRoute.title: Visit Victoria — Great Southern Touring Route

roadTrip.summary: A compact seven-day loop with only three lodging bases: one night in Fairhaven, one in Apollo Bay, and four in Halls Gap. Keep the Pole House, Otways ziplining, Shipwreck Coast, Tower Hill, mountain biking, and Sovereign Hill; accept two purposeful long driving days to avoid repeated packing.

days.drive: About 1½ hours direct, plus coastal stops
plan: Leave Geelong after breakfast and begin the Great Ocean Road at an unhurried pace.
Stop at the Pole House and spend time on Fairhaven Beach.
Choose one additional coast stop, then settle into the Fairhaven base.
options: Split Point Lighthouse at Aireys Inlet

days.drive: About 2½ hours across the day, plus the activity
plan: Make the Otway Fly zipline tour the day's anchor and allow roughly half a day for check-in, briefing, and the guided course.
Continue to Apollo Bay for the loop's only night there.
Keep the evening simple: beach, groceries, and an early dinner.
options: Short rainforest stop if energy and daylight allow

days.route: Apollo Bay → Shipwreck Coast → Tower Hill → Halls Gap
days.drive: About 5–5½ hours without sightseeing; deliberately the longest day
plan: Leave early and make the Twelve Apostles and Loch Ard Gorge the essential coast stops.
Continue to Tower Hill Wildlife Reserve for a short wildlife and cultural stop.
Skip a Port Fairy overnight and continue directly to Halls Gap, arriving in the evening.
options: Gibson Steps if open and safe
London Bridge or Bay of Islands, but not every lookout

links.title: Tower Hill Wildlife Reserve visitor guide

plan: Reserve a half-day family mountain-bike or e-bike outing on age-appropriate trails.
Keep the second half deliberately light after the long transfer day.
Morning anchor: The Pinnacle from Sundial Carpark, 4.2 km return; allow about 2½ hours with children.
After lunch choose one low-key addition. The Pinnacle is the day's accomplishment.
Book one half-day guided activity: beginner rock climbing, abseiling, or a guided family hike; confirm minimum ages.
Use the other half for something gentle and keep the final Halls Gap evening relaxed.
options: Brambuk and nearby walks, subject to reopening
Halls Gap Zoo in bad weather
Return to a favourite lookout for sunset

days.drive: About 3½ hours total, split by the Sovereign Hill day
plan: Leave Halls Gap early enough to reach Sovereign Hill for opening.
Spend the full opening day at Sovereign Hill, prioritizing gold panning, demonstrations, rare trades, Red Hill Mine, and a prebooked mine tour if wanted.
Leave near closing, drive to Melbourne, and return the rental car that evening or Saturday morning.

bookFirst: Family-size Fairhaven house near the Pole House
Halls Gap accommodation for four nights
Sovereign Hill and its mine tour
One-way rental car: Geelong pickup, Melbourne return

notes: Arrive late Friday after Sovereign Hill.
Use all of Saturday and most of Sunday for Melbourne.
See the fairy penguins at St Kilda Pier on Friday or Saturday evening.
Settle in Sunday evening and protect a normal Monday-through-Friday work and homeschool week.
Use afternoons and evenings for nearby Sydney activities.
Reserve one evening for a performance at the Sydney Opera House.
Keep Saturday for a full Sydney day, then fly to Hamilton Island on Sunday.
